package.description: Real-time physical RAM squarified treemap visualizer and process monitor for Windows.

en-US.description: Real-time physical RAM squarified treemap visualizer and process monitor for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
RAMView is a modern, lightweight physical memory visualizer for Windows.
It maps real-time hardware Working Set memory into an interactive squarified
treemap with official application identities and safe process termination.
en-US.name: RAMView
